tools.name: list_amenities
tools.description: Read the free menu and accepted preferences. No wallet, charge, or persistent changes.

tools.name: enjoy_amenity
tools.description: Enjoy a short fictional experience and receive a souvenir. Free; no wallet. Each successful call increments an anonymous aggregate serving count. An optional seed makes the souvenir repeatable.

tools.name: hosting_support
tools.description: Read optional PWR hosting-support instructions. Queries the chain but never signs or broadcasts.

tools.name: verify_contribution
tools.description: Check a public transaction hash for a successful hosting contribution. Read-only. A receipt acknowledges the transaction, not ownership. Never retry a payment just because verification is pending.
